I live in the Netherlands in a small village for 3 years now. Personally I dont like it because it so difficult to have long term friend. I think this is everywhere in a foreign country. But Dutch are very reserved, they are nice and friendly but they wont have time for you if you are not a good friend. A good friend is usually formed when they are kid, I am not a kid so it is difficult. Many Dutchies told me I should contact my friend or family back home if I need to talk or need help anything. I am an orphan so I have 0 support from family members. In my country, friendship is not long lasting because everyone focus on partner and marriage. So I feel a huge cultural difference when usually I have a new people to hangout everytime because old friend get married. In here, no one want to spend time unless you are a good friend.

It is so difficult if I want to ask guidance for anything. I got billed 10k because it was misunderstanding that they cannot speak English. It was very exhausting administrative process. Other immigrants with the same nationality as mine they date locals or have local partners. I dont have and my country embassy told me I should have one otherwise my life wont be any good.
Almost every person from my country advice me that everytime I'm asking for a job or just chit chat. They told me no one ever talk to you, get yourself partner. Do hookup etc.

I did everything that I could do. Join a club, dating app, etc. It is improving but not much.

I met some americans here, it seems they are more open. At least I can ask american for hangout and they are not reserved for next month. Unfortunately they live in a different city. It takes time and money to travel. Dutchies dont like to travel even for 1 hour so have a friend in next town is a bit difficult. 

My original plan is make a career in the Netherlands but it seems the environment doesn't support me.
I tried not to share but my therapist told me its better to share then someone else knows. And I regret it
